purpose: Fill the 8 under-filled narrow boards created 2026-07-27

pins.pin_title: 8 Hours on Low, One Bag of Dried Beans, 8 Bowls of Dinner
pins.pin_description: Two pounds of dried pinto beans, a pound of smoked sausage, and 8 to 10 hours on low. That's dinner for 8 out of one slow cooker, at about 420 calories a bowl. Cheap crockpot meals for large families work because the crockpot doesn't care that the beans came from a bag instead of a can.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading 8 hours on low, one bag of dried beans, 8 bowls of dinner, over a line about cheap crockpot meals for large families.
pins.claim: 8 Hours on Low, One Bag of Dried Beans, 8 Bowls of Dinner.
pins.support: Cheap crockpot meals for large families

pins.pin_title: Pork Shoulder Under $2 a Pound Turns Into Three Different Dinners
pins.pin_description: If pork shoulder is under two dollars a pound, buy two. One roast becomes pulled pork on Monday, carnitas on Tuesday, and a pork heavy stew on Wednesday. It's almost impossible to overcook, which is why it anchors cheap crockpot meals for large families.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading pork shoulder under $2 a pound turns into three dinners, with a note about pulled pork, carnitas and stew.
pins.claim: Pork Shoulder Under $2 a Pound Turns Into Three Dinners.
pins.support: Pulled pork, then carnitas, then stew

pins.pin_title: Salt the Beans at the End or You Get Gravel
pins.pin_description: Salt early and bean skins can toughen up on you. Rinse the dried beans, pick out the tiny rocks that end up in every bag, and season only once they're soft. A bag of dried pinto beans costs next to nothing and swells to three times its size, which is the whole engine behind cheap meals for large families.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading salt the beans at the end or you get gravel, with a line noting dried beans swell to three times their size.
pins.claim: Salt the Beans at the End or You Get Gravel.
pins.support: Dried beans swell to three times their size

pins.pin_title: A Gallon of Chili and Ten People? Serve It Over Baked Potatoes
pins.pin_description: The secret to feeding a crowd isn't more meat, it's what goes underneath it. Chili over baked potatoes, stew over a big pot of rice, brown rice or extra root vegetables folded into the pot. Cheap crockpot meals for large families are about volume, heat, and enough seasoning to make a five pound bag of potatoes taste like a luxury.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin asking what to do with a gallon of chili and ten people, answering serve it over baked potatoes.
pins.claim: A Gallon of Chili and Ten People? Serve It Over Baked Potatoes.
pins.support: The oldest trick for feeding a crowd

pins.pin_title: A 50/50 Ratio of Beef to Filler Feeds Twice the Table
pins.pin_description: Aim for half meat and half everything else. One bite of potato for every bite of beef fills people up faster and keeps the grocery bill from hitting triple digits before Tuesday. It's the cheapest ground beef move for large families and nobody at the table notices.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading a 50/50 ratio of beef to filler feeds twice the table.
pins.claim: A 50/50 Ratio of Beef to Filler Feeds Twice the Table.
pins.support: One bite of potato for every bite of beef
pins.footer: Stretch the meat, not the budget

pins.pin_title: Don't Let the 73/27 Ground Beef Label Scare You Off
pins.pin_description: The cheapest ground beef is usually the stuff with the highest fat percentage. You're going to drain most of that anyway, or better yet, use it to cook your vegetables. Cheap ground beef meals for large families start in the aisle everybody walks past.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin about the 73/27 ground beef label, with a support line saying you are draining most of that fat anyway.
pins.claim: Don't Let the 73/27 Label Scare You Off.
pins.support: You are draining most of that fat anyway
pins.footer: Stretch the meat, not the budget

pins.pin_title: Freeze Ground Beef in Flat One Pound Squares. They Thaw in 20 Minutes
pins.pin_description: Flat squares thaw in about twenty minutes in a sink of warm water, which is a lifesaver when you realize at 5 PM that you forgot to take anything out. Portion it once and cheap ground beef meals for large families stop depending on your memory.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading freeze ground beef in flat one pound squares, they thaw in about twenty minutes.
pins.claim: Freeze Ground Beef in Flat One Pound Squares.
pins.support: They thaw in about twenty minutes
pins.footer: Stretch the meat, not the budget

pins.pin_title: Beef and Broccoli Uses Almost No Beef. The Rice Does the Heavy Lifting
pins.pin_description: Rice based dishes stretch a small amount of meat further than anything else in the kitchen. A beef and broccoli stir fry leans on the rice and the bulky florets, so very little meat has to cover the whole table. Cheap ground beef meals for large families live or die on the bag of rice in the pantry.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading beef and broccoli uses almost no beef, the rice does the work.
pins.claim: Beef and Broccoli Uses Almost No Beef. The Rice Does the Work.
pins.support: A 20 pound bag of rice is the real staple
pins.footer: Stretch the meat, not the budget

pins.pin_title: If the Recipe Calls for Two Pounds of Beef, Use One
pins.pin_description: Finely chopped mushrooms, cooked lentils, or grated zucchini fill the space that second pound used to take, and they soak up the fat and spices while they cook. It works best in heavy sauces like bolognese or taco meat. That's how to stretch meals for large families without anyone catching on.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading if the recipe calls for two pounds of beef, use one.
pins.claim: If the Recipe Calls for Two Pounds of Beef, Use One.
pins.support: Mushrooms or lentils take the other pound's place
pins.footer: Fillers, sides, and a smaller pound of meat

pins.pin_title: A Cup of Dry Beans and Two Thirds of a Cup of Rice Covers One Adult for a Day
pins.pin_description: Stop guessing at the pot size. A cup of dry beans plus two thirds of a cup of dry rice covers one adult for a full day, so you can scale by head count instead of vibes. It's the least stressful way to stretch meals for large families.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading a cup of dry beans and two thirds of a cup of rice covers one adult for a day.
pins.claim: A Cup of Dry Beans and Two Thirds of a Cup of Rice Covers One Adult for a Day.
pins.support: Scale by head count instead of guessing
pins.footer: Fillers, sides, and a smaller pound of meat

pins.pin_title: A Handful of Quick Oats Disappears Into Thin Soup and Thickens It
pins.pin_description: Liquid doesn't keep anybody full. A can of white beans adds creaminess, potatoes act like flavor sponges, and a handful of quick cooking oats vanishes into the broth and thickens it. That's how you stretch meals for large families without buying more meat.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading a handful of quick oats disappears into thin soup and thickens it.
pins.claim: A Handful of Quick Oats Disappears Into Thin Soup and Thickens It.
pins.support: Liquid does not keep people full. Bulk does.
pins.footer: Fillers, sides, and a smaller pound of meat

pins.pin_title: The Side Dish Should Do the Heavy Lifting, Not the Meat
pins.pin_description: A massive pot of seasoned yellow rice, a cheap loaf sliced and toasted with garlic butter, or a tray of roasted carrots and onions can take up half the plate for pennies. Learning to stretch meals for large families is mostly learning to stop treating the side as an afterthought.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading the side dish should do the heavy lifting, not the meat.
pins.claim: The Side Dish Should Do the Heavy Lifting, Not the Meat.
pins.support: Seasoned rice, garlic toast, roasted carrots
pins.footer: Fillers, sides, and a smaller pound of meat

pins.pin_title: Six Eggs, Six Breakfast Burritos, Three Months in the Freezer
pins.pin_description: Six eggs across six burritos, plus a can of black beans and a cup of shredded cheese doing the rest of the work. These high protein breakfast burritos hold up for about 3 months in the freezer. Vegetarian, roughly 380 calories each, and no drive-thru involved.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading six eggs, six breakfast burritos, three months in the freezer.
pins.claim: Six Eggs, Six Breakfast Burritos, Three Months in the Freezer.
pins.support: Black beans and cheese do the rest

pins.pin_title: Frozen Breakfast Burrito: 2 Minutes, Flip, 1 to 2 More
pins.pin_description: Take the wrapping off, microwave 2 minutes, flip it, then go another 1 to 2 minutes. Don't thaw it in the fridge overnight and then microwave it, because the texture falls apart on that cycle. A breakfast burrito is only a good idea if reheating is this boring.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading straight from frozen, 2 minutes, flip, 1 to 2 more.
pins.claim: Straight From Frozen: 2 Minutes, Flip, 1 to 2 More.
pins.support: Do not thaw overnight and then microwave

pins.pin_title: Bake Breakfast Burritos 8 Minutes at 400F Before They See the Freezer
pins.pin_description: Seam side down, a sprinkle of cheese on top, 8 to 10 minutes at 400F. That bake sets the cheese and seals the tortilla edges, which is the difference between a high protein breakfast burrito and a soggy one. Cool completely, then wrap and freeze.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading bake the burritos 8 minutes at 400F before they see the freezer.
pins.claim: Bake the Burritos 8 Minutes at 400F Before They See the Freezer.
pins.support: That bake sets the cheese and seals the edges

pins.pin_title: 380 Calories a Breakfast Burrito, No Meat Anywhere In It
pins.pin_description: Eggs, black beans, corn, bell peppers, onion, cheese and salsa, rolled into 6 burritos at about 380 calories each. High protein breakfast ideas don't have to involve standing at a stove at 7 AM, because these come out of the freezer already built.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading 380 calories a breakfast burrito, no meat anywhere in it.
pins.claim: 380 Calories a Breakfast Burrito, No Meat Anywhere In It.
pins.support: Eggs, black beans, corn, peppers, cheese, salsa

pins.pin_title: 1 Cup of Oats, 2 Cups of Broth, and Breakfast Stops Being Sweet
pins.pin_description: Use a 1 to 2 ratio, oats to water or broth, and cook 5 to 7 minutes until it's thick and creamy. Savory oatmeal treats the grain like rice, something to hold your toppings instead of being the star. Broth is the single change that makes the whole bowl work.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading 1 cup of oats, 2 cups of broth, and breakfast stops being sweet.
pins.claim: 1 Cup of Oats, 2 Cups of Broth, and Breakfast Stops Being Sweet.
pins.support: Savory oatmeal cooks in 5 to 7 minutes
pins.footer: Oats, broth, one egg, ten minutes

pins.pin_title: One Egg Adds About 6 Grams of Protein to Savory Oatmeal
pins.pin_description: The egg isn't decoration. About 6 grams of protein is what turns a bowl of savory oatmeal from a side dish into a breakfast that actually holds. Poached, soft fried, or scrambled, the yolk ends up as the sauce either way.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading one egg adds about 6 grams of protein, that is the difference.
pins.claim: One Egg Adds About 6 Grams of Protein. That Is the Difference.
pins.support: It turns a side dish into a real breakfast
pins.footer: Oats, broth, one egg, ten minutes

pins.pin_title: Poach the Egg 3 to 4 Minutes and Let the Yolk Be the Sauce
pins.pin_description: Drop a cracked egg into simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes. The whites set, the yolk stays runny, and when you cut into it the yolk mixes straight through the savory oatmeal. No cream, no butter, no second pan.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading poach the egg 3 to 4 minutes and let the yolk be the sauce.
pins.claim: Poach the Egg 3 to 4 Minutes and Let the Yolk Be the Sauce.
pins.support: Simmering water, a splash of vinegar, done
pins.footer: Oats, broth, one egg, ten minutes

pins.pin_title: Savory Oatmeal Keeps 4 Days in the Fridge
pins.pin_description: Cook it, cool it completely, and store it airtight for up to 4 days. Reheat a portion in the microwave with about 2 tablespoons of water and it loosens right back up. Savory oatmeal is the high protein breakfast that survives a real weekday.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading savory oatmeal keeps 4 days in the fridge, reheat with about 2 tablespoons of water.
pins.claim: Savory Oatmeal Keeps 4 Days in the Fridge.
pins.support: Reheat with about 2 tablespoons of water
pins.footer: Oats, broth, one egg, ten minutes

pins.pin_title: Breakfast Hash Timing: Vegetables 25 to 30 Minutes, Eggs 8 to 12
pins.pin_description: At 425F the sweet potatoes need twenty-five to thirty minutes to get good color, while eggs set in about eight to twelve. Roast the vegetables first, make wells, then crack the eggs in at the end. That timing is the entire breakfast hash.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading the vegetables need 25 to 30 minutes, the eggs need 8 to 12.
pins.claim: The Vegetables Need 25 to 30 Minutes. The Eggs Need 8 to 12.
pins.support: So the eggs go in last, not at the start

pins.pin_title: Single Layer, With Gaps, or the Sweet Potatoes Just Steam
pins.pin_description: Four cups of sweet potato dumped onto one pan with no breathing room steams instead of roasting. You want a single layer with gaps between the pieces, even if that means splitting it across two pans. It's the difference between a crisp breakfast hash and a soft one.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading single layer with gaps, stack them and you made a casserole.
pins.claim: Single Layer, With Gaps. Stack Them and You Made a Casserole.
pins.support: Crowded sweet potatoes steam instead of roasting

pins.pin_title: A Half Sheet Pan Is 18 by 13 Inches, and This Breakfast Hash Assumes It
pins.pin_description: A standard half sheet pan measures 18 by 13 inches. If yours is a quarter sheet at roughly 9 by 13, split the breakfast hash across two pans or cook it in two rounds. Pan size decides whether you get crisp edges or steamed cubes.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading a half sheet pan is 18 by 13 inches, this recipe assumes it.
pins.claim: A Half Sheet Pan Is 18 by 13 Inches. This Recipe Assumes It.
pins.support: A quarter sheet means two pans or two rounds

pins.pin_title: Your Oven Needs 10 to 15 Minutes to Recover After You Open the Door
pins.pin_description: Most ovens take ten to fifteen minutes to fully come back up after the door opens. Slide a breakfast hash into a 425F oven that hasn't stabilized and every time in the recipe drifts. Give it the full preheat and stop wondering why the sweet potatoes are pale.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading your oven needs 10 to 15 minutes to recover after you open it.
pins.claim: Your Oven Needs 10 to 15 Minutes to Recover After You Open It.
pins.support: Otherwise every cooking time quietly drifts

pins.pin_title: Put the Snack Bin at Eye Level. Visibility Is Half the Battle
pins.pin_description: A clear bin on the middle shelf beats the bottom crisper every time, because things go to the crisper to die. When you open the door it should be the first thing you see. That's the entire idea behind a grab and go snack drawer.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading put the snack bin at eye level, visibility is half the battle.
pins.kicker: The grab and go snack drawer
pins.claim: Put the Snack Bin at Eye Level. Visibility Is Half the Battle.
pins.support: The crisper drawer is where food gets forgotten
pins.footer: One visible bin, restocked twice a week

pins.pin_title: If It Needs Washing or Peeling, It Doesn't Belong in the Snack Drawer
pins.pin_description: Everything in the bin has to be completely ready to eat. Whole unwashed carrots miss the point, because at four in the afternoon you're taking the path of least resistance every single time. Fill the snack drawer with things you can grab one handed.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading if it needs washing or peeling, it does not belong in the drawer.
pins.kicker: The grab and go snack drawer
pins.claim: If It Needs Washing or Peeling, It Does Not Belong in the Drawer.
pins.support: Nobody peels a carrot at four in the afternoon
pins.footer: One visible bin, restocked twice a week

pins.pin_title: Restock the Snack Drawer 3 to 4 Days at a Time
pins.pin_description: Prep too far ahead and the cut produce dries out or turns slimy before anybody eats it. Twice a week keeps the snack drawer appealing instead of guilt inducing. Small batches, visible bin, done.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading restock the snack drawer 3 to 4 days at a time, not two weeks.
pins.kicker: The grab and go snack drawer
pins.claim: Restock the Snack Drawer 3 to 4 Days at a Time, Not Two Weeks.
pins.support: Cut produce dries out before you get to it
pins.footer: One visible bin, restocked twice a week

pins.pin_title: Date the Hard-Boiled Eggs and Use Them Within One Week
pins.pin_description: Hard-boiled eggs anchor a good snack drawer, but they come with rules. Refrigerate within two hours of cooking, write the date on the container, and use them within one week. Keep the fridge at 40F or below and keep the bin away from any raw meat package that could leak.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading date the hard-boiled eggs and use them within one week.
pins.kicker: The grab and go snack drawer
pins.claim: Date the Hard-Boiled Eggs and Use Them Within One Week.
pins.support: Keep the fridge at 40F or below
pins.footer: One visible bin, restocked twice a week

pins.pin_title: Three Cups of Air-Popped Popcorn Is About 90 Calories
pins.pin_description: If you want to eat a giant bowl of something in front of the TV, popcorn is the only logical pick. Three cups of air-popped runs about 90 calories, and the volume to calorie ratio is unbeatable. Chips give you four bites and a greasy hand.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading three cups of air-popped popcorn is about 90 calories.
pins.claim: Three Cups of Air-Popped Popcorn Is About 90 Calories.
pins.support: Try that with chips and you get four bites

pins.pin_title: Slice Sweet Potatoes Paper Thin and Bake Them at 300 Degrees
pins.pin_description: Beets, sweet potatoes and parsnips make far better chips than the store-bought veggie versions. Slice them paper thin, toss with a tiny bit of oil, and go low at 300 degrees. You're basically dehydrating them, so it takes longer than you think.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading slice sweet potatoes paper thin and bake them at 300 degrees.
pins.claim: Slice Sweet Potatoes Paper Thin and Bake Them at 300 Degrees.
pins.support: You are dehydrating them, so give it time

pins.pin_title: At 3 PM Your Brain Wants Salty and Crunchy, Not a Lecture
pins.pin_description: You don't have to swear off potatoes forever to make a better call in the afternoon. Most of the time you just want a break and something salty to chew on while you stare at a screen. Popcorn, nuts and seeds, or thin vegetable chips all land in the same place.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading at 3 PM your brain wants salty and crunchy, not a lecture.
pins.claim: At 3 PM Your Brain Wants Salty and Crunchy, Not a Lecture.
pins.support: Swap the chip, keep the crunch

pins.pin_title: Most Store-Bought Veggie Chips Are Potato Starch Dyed Green
pins.pin_description: Read the ingredients on a bag of veggie chips and it's usually potato starch with spinach powder for color. Slicing your own beets or parsnips takes a mandoline and a little patience, and it beats paying extra for the costume. Better snack, same crunch.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading most store-bought veggie chips are potato starch dyed green.
pins.claim: Most Store-Bought Veggie Chips Are Potato Starch Dyed Green.
pins.support: Spinach powder is not a vegetable serving

pins.pin_title: 7 Popcorn Toppings That Don't Taste Like Diet Food
pins.pin_description: Lime zest with a pinch of heat, nutritional yeast with garlic, Parmesan and cracked pepper, sesame and nori, dill and onion, cocoa and cinnamon, and crushed freeze-dried berries. Seven ways to give plain popcorn a real personality without a syrup or a sauce.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading 7 popcorn toppings that do not taste like diet food.
pins.claim: 7 Popcorn Toppings That Do Not Taste Like Diet Food.
pins.support: Chili-lime, cocoa-cinnamon, Parmesan-pepper
pins.footer: Savory, sweet, and none of them sticky

pins.pin_title: 8 Cups of Popcorn, 1 to 2 Teaspoons of Oil, 1 Tablespoon of Seasoning
pins.pin_description: For roughly 8 cups of popped popcorn, start with 1 to 2 teaspoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of dry seasoning. Toss, taste, and add another teaspoon or two only if the bowl asks for it. Parmesan and soy sauce powder bring their own salt, so taste first.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading 8 cups of popcorn, 1 to 2 teaspoons of oil, 1 tablespoon of seasoning.
pins.claim: 8 Cups of Popcorn, 1 to 2 Teaspoons of Oil, 1 Tablespoon of Seasoning.
pins.support: Toss, taste, then add more only if it needs it
pins.footer: Savory, sweet, and none of them sticky

pins.pin_title: Cocoa Goes From Pleasantly Dark to Drywall Dust With Impressive Speed
pins.pin_description: Unsweetened cocoa with cinnamon and a small amount of sugar makes popcorn taste like a treat instead of a punishment. Add the cocoa gradually, because it turns on you fast. A pinch of salt makes the chocolate read clearer.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading cocoa goes from pleasantly dark to drywall dust with real speed.
pins.claim: Cocoa Goes From Pleasantly Dark to Drywall Dust With Real Speed.
pins.support: Add it gradually. A pinch of salt sharpens it.
pins.footer: Savory, sweet, and none of them sticky

pins.pin_title: Whole Sesame Seeds Race to the Bottom of the Bowl. Crush Some First
pins.pin_description: Crush a sheet of nori into small flakes and mix it with toasted sesame seeds for a popcorn topping nobody expects. Whole seeds sink, so crush part of them and the mix actually clings. Soy sauce powder helps if you keep it around.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading whole sesame seeds race to the bottom of the bowl.
pins.claim: Whole Sesame Seeds Race to the Bottom of the Bowl.
pins.support: Crush some first so the topping clings
pins.footer: Savory, sweet, and none of them sticky

pins.pin_title: Aim for 8 to 10 Grams of Fiber Before Noon
pins.pin_description: You don't need to hit the whole day's fiber at breakfast. Roughly 8 to 10 grams in the morning already puts you ahead of most muffin and latte routines. Stack any two easy high fiber breakfast foods and you're there before you've properly woken up.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading aim for 8 to 10 grams of fiber before noon.
pins.claim: Aim for 8 to 10 Grams of Fiber Before Noon.
pins.support: That already beats the muffin and latte routine
pins.footer: Real food, not a morning science project

pins.pin_title: Oatmeal 4 Grams, a Spoon of Chia 5, a Cup of Raspberries 8
pins.pin_description: A cup of cooked oatmeal lands around 4 grams of fiber, a tablespoon of chia seeds adds about 5, and a cup of raspberries brings roughly 8. High fiber breakfast ideas are less about discovering weird ingredients and more about combining normal ones on purpose.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin listing oatmeal 4 grams, a spoon of chia 5, a cup of raspberries 8.
pins.claim: Oatmeal 4 Grams. A Spoon of Chia 5. A Cup of Raspberries 8.
pins.support: Stack any two and breakfast is handled
pins.footer: Real food, not a morning science project

pins.pin_title: Overnight Oats Can Clear 10 Grams of Fiber Before You Open Your Eyes
pins.pin_description: Oats, milk, chia and berries left in a jar overnight is often 10 plus grams of fiber before you're fully awake. The chia thickens it so it feels like pudding instead of cold porridge. Easiest high fiber breakfast on the list, and it makes itself.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading overnight oats can clear 10 grams of fiber before you wake up.
pins.claim: Overnight Oats Can Clear 10 Grams of Fiber Before You Wake Up.
pins.support: The chia thickens the jar so it eats like pudding
pins.footer: Real food, not a morning science project

pins.pin_title: Jumping From White Toast to 20 Grams of Fiber Is Why People Quit
pins.pin_description: If your current breakfast is mostly white toast, go slow. Going from almost no fiber to 20 grams before work is how people decide fiber doesn't agree with them. Add a bit more each week, drink water with it, and let a high fiber breakfast settle in.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading jumping from white toast to 20 grams of fiber is why people quit.
pins.claim: Jumping From White Toast to 20 Grams of Fiber Is Why People Quit.
pins.support: Add a little each week and drink water with it
pins.footer: Real food, not a morning science project

pins.pin_title: Bread, Beans, Seeds: Three Levers That Make Avocado Toast a Real Meal
pins.pin_description: Bread with real whole grains near the top of the ingredient list, a topping that is not just salt, and something crunchy that isn't only there for the photo. That's high fiber avocado toast in three moves, at about 340 calories a serving.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading bread, beans, seeds, three levers make avocado toast a meal.
pins.claim: Bread, Beans, Seeds. Three Levers Make Avocado Toast a Meal.
pins.support: No long ingredient list required

pins.pin_title: Mashed Black Beans and Lime Turn Avocado Toast Into Actual Breakfast
pins.pin_description: Mash half a cup of rinsed black beans with a fork, spoon them over the avocado, and hit it with lime so it tastes bright instead of heavy. This is the avocado toast variation for people who want something closer to a meal than a snack.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading mashed black beans and lime turn avocado toast into breakfast.
pins.claim: Mashed Black Beans and Lime Turn Avocado Toast Into Breakfast.
pins.support: Half a cup, mashed with a fork, salted

pins.pin_title: Spread Hummus Under the Avocado So the Toast Doesn't Go Soggy
pins.pin_description: A thin layer of hummus first, then avocado, cucumber slices and everything seasoning. It's the coolest of the avocado toast variations, which matters on mornings when hot food sounds like a bad idea. Assemble right before you eat it.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading spread hummus under the avocado so the toast stays crisp.
pins.claim: Spread Hummus Under the Avocado So the Toast Stays Crisp.
pins.support: Then cucumber slices and everything seasoning

pins.pin_title: A 5 Day Avocado Toast Rotation So You Stop Repeating Yourself
pins.pin_description: Beans and lime on Monday, tomatoes and seeds on Tuesday, hummus and cucumber on Wednesday, salsa and corn on Thursday, tahini and lemon zest on Friday. Same ten minutes every morning, five different high fiber breakfasts.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading a 5 day avocado toast rotation so you stop repeating yourself.
pins.claim: A 5 Day Avocado Toast Rotation So You Stop Repeating Yourself.
pins.support: Beans, tomatoes, hummus, salsa, tahini

pins.pin_title: 3 Tablespoons of Chia to 1 Cup of Liquid. That's the Ratio
pins.pin_description: The base for savory chia is 3 tablespoons of chia seeds to 1 cup of liquid. Broth or a savory milk base both work. It's the prep-ahead high fiber breakfast for people who are tired of sweet chia pudding and want something salty instead.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading 3 tablespoons of chia to 1 cup of liquid, that is the ratio.
pins.claim: 3 Tablespoons of Chia to 1 Cup of Liquid. That Is the Ratio.
pins.support: Savory chia, not another sweet pudding

pins.pin_title: Stir Once, Wait 5 Minutes, Stir Again
pins.pin_description: That second stir is what saves you from a clump at the bottom that looks like it made a decision without you. Five minutes is the whole wait. Savory chia sets up smooth and stays that way through the week.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading stir once, wait 5 minutes, stir again, that second stir saves you.
pins.claim: Stir Once, Wait 5 Minutes, Stir Again. That Second Stir Saves You.
pins.support: Otherwise you get a clump at the bottom

pins.pin_title: The Savory Chia Base Keeps About 4 Days in the Fridge
pins.pin_description: Make two or three jars at a time, because anything past that starts to feel like running a chia operation out of your refrigerator. The base holds about 4 days. Keep the toppings in a separate container so nothing goes soft on you.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading the savory chia base keeps about 4 days in the fridge.
pins.claim: The Savory Chia Base Keeps About 4 Days in the Fridge.
pins.support: Two or three jars at a time, not seven

pins.pin_title: Pack the Toppings Separately. Nobody Wants Pressed Avocado at 7 AM
pins.pin_description: If you're taking savory chia to the office, keep the avocado, herbs and crunchy bits in their own container. Chia that's been pressed against avocado since 7 AM gets dramatic in the wrong direction. The toppings are what make it read as breakfast.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading pack the toppings separately, nobody wants pressed avocado at 7 AM.
pins.claim: Pack the Toppings Separately. Nobody Wants Pressed Avocado at 7 AM.
pins.support: Toppings are what make savory chia breakfast

pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: USDA Puts One Adult at $303 to $381 a Month for Food at Home
pins.pin_description: The thrifty benchmark works out to about $303 a month for a woman living alone and $381 for a man, using May 2026 prices. That range already includes the 20 percent USDA adds for one person households. Use it as a shape to compare your own grocery spending against, not as a quote.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading USDA puts one adult at $303 to $381 a month for food at home.
pins.claim: USDA Puts One Adult at $303 to $381 a Month for Food at Home.
pins.support: May 2026 prices, single-shopper add included

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: Shopping for One Costs 20 Percent More Per Person, and USDA Priced It
pins.pin_description: USDA says to add 20 percent to the individual weekly cost for a one person household, 10 percent for two, and 5 percent for three. Smaller packages, more waste, and no way to buy the loss leader case. USDA priced the penalty, it didn't invent it.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading shopping for one costs 20 percent more per person.
pins.claim: Shopping for One Costs 20 Percent More Per Person.
pins.support: Smaller packages, more waste, no case discounts

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: $73.20 a Week for a Man, $58.20 for a Woman, Then Add 20 Percent
pins.pin_description: USDA's May 2026 individual weekly costs are $73.20 for an adult man aged 20 to 50 and $58.20 for an adult woman in the same band. Add the one person 20 percent and you get $87.84 and $69.84 a week. That's where the monthly grocery number actually comes from.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading $73.20 a week for a man, $58.20 for a woman, then add 20 percent.
pins.claim: $73.20 a Week for a Man, $58.20 for a Woman, Then Add 20 Percent.
pins.support: Which lands at $87.84 and $69.84 a week

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: That Grocery Benchmark Is Food at Home. Takeout Isn't In It
pins.pin_description: USDA's number covers food eaten at home. No restaurants, no delivery fees, no coffee bought because the morning went sideways. If your $400 includes three takeout meals, you're not overspending on groceries, you're spending on something else that happens to arrive on a plate.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading that grocery benchmark is food at home, takeout is not in it.
pins.claim: That Grocery Benchmark Is Food at Home. Takeout Is Not In It.
pins.support: No restaurants, no delivery fees, no rescue coffee

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: USDA Says a Household of Four Can Eat at Home for $235 a Week
pins.pin_description: The Thrifty Food Plan puts the reference household of four at $235.00 a week and $1,018.20 a month, using May 2026 prices. That's $33.57 a day for the whole house. It's a benchmark USDA built, not a shopping list it wrote for you.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading USDA says a household of four can eat at home for $235 a week.
pins.claim: USDA Says a Household of Four Can Eat at Home for $235 a Week.
pins.support: $1,018.20 a month, on May 2026 prices

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: $235 a Week Works Out to $8.39 Per Person Per Day
pins.pin_description: Divide USDA's weekly grocery benchmark across 4 people and 7 days and you land at about $8.39 per person per day. At three meals a day that averages roughly $2.80 a plate. It's an illustration, not an instruction to make every plate cost the same.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading $235 a week works out to $8.39 per person per day.
pins.claim: $235 a Week Works Out to $8.39 Per Person Per Day.
pins.support: About $2.80 a plate at three meals a day

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: USDA Doesn't Split the Grocery Money Into Four Equal Envelopes
pins.pin_description: The report assigns $73.20 a week to the adult man, $58.20 to the adult woman, $55.50 to the older child and $48.00 to the younger one. The displayed numbers add to $234.90 while USDA reports $235.00 from unrounded amounts. Ten cents of federal rounding, nobody is hiding anything.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading USDA does not split the grocery money into four equal envelopes.
pins.claim: USDA Does Not Split the Grocery Money Into Four Equal Envelopes.

pins.board_intended: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.board_routed: Grocery Budget Tips and Shopping Lists
pins.pin_title: Add 20 Percent for One Person, 10 for Two, 5 for Three
pins.pin_description: USDA adjusts its grocery benchmark by household size: add 20 percent for one person, 10 percent for two, and 5 percent for three. Four gets no change, five or six subtract 5 percent, and seven or more subtract 10. That's how the thrifty table turns into your own shopping list.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading add 20 percent for one person, 10 for two, 5 for three.
pins.claim: Add 20 Percent for One Person, 10 for Two, 5 for Three.
pins.support: Then subtract 5 at six people and 10 at seven

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: Crusty Homemade Bread Lives on the Counter, Cut Side Down
pins.pin_description: A crackly crust and a plastic bag are enemies. For the first day or two, set the loaf cut side down on a wooden surface or in a paper bag and leave it alone. Storing homemade bread is mostly about matching the method to the crust you worked for.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading crusty homemade bread lives on the counter, cut side down.
pins.claim: Crusty Homemade Bread Lives on the Counter, Cut Side Down.
pins.support: One or two days, no plastic near it
pins.footer: Match the method to the crust

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: Soft Homemade Bread Keeps 3 to 4 Days in Airtight Storage
pins.pin_description: Airtight is right for a soft loaf, but only once the bread has cooled all the way through. Seal it warm and the trapped steam turns the crust gummy and invites mold early. Cool completely first, and homemade bread stretches to 3 or 4 good days.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading soft homemade bread keeps 3 to 4 days in airtight storage.
pins.claim: Soft Homemade Bread Keeps 3 to 4 Days in Airtight Storage.
pins.support: Cool it completely first or you trap steam
pins.footer: Match the method to the crust

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: Freeze Homemade Bread in Slices. They Go Straight in the Toaster
pins.pin_description: Slice before you freeze and future you takes out exactly what the morning needs. Frozen slices go straight into the toaster, or thaw at room temperature in about 20 to 30 minutes. It beats watching half a loaf of homemade bread go stale on the counter.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading freeze homemade bread in slices, they go straight in the toaster.
pins.claim: Freeze Homemade Bread in Slices. They Go Straight in the Toaster.
pins.support: Or thaw on the counter in 20 to 30 minutes
pins.footer: Match the method to the crust

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: A 300F Oven for 5 to 10 Minutes Brings a Stale Loaf Back, Briefly
pins.pin_description: Stale is dry and leathery, and it's fixable. Mist the crust lightly with water and warm the loaf at 300F for 5 to 10 minutes. It won't be the hour it left the oven, but it beats the alternative, and stale homemade bread still becomes toast, croutons or breadcrumbs.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading a 300F oven for 5 to 10 minutes brings a stale loaf back.
pins.claim: A 300F Oven for 5 to 10 Minutes Brings a Stale Loaf Back.
pins.support: Mist the crust first, then eat it that day
pins.footer: Match the method to the crust

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: One Cup of Sourdough Discard Is About 227 Grams
pins.pin_description: 227 grams per cup is the conversion King Arthur Baking uses, and it assumes a typical 100 percent hydration starter with equal weights of flour and water. Weigh it in the mixing bowl and the sticky measuring cup never enters the picture.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading one cup of sourdough discard is about 227 grams.
pins.claim: One Cup of Sourdough Discard Is About 227 Grams.
pins.support: For a typical 100 percent hydration starter

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: Half a Cup of Sourdough Discard Is About 113 Grams
pins.pin_description: 113 grams comes straight out of the 227 gram cup. If you've seen 120 or 125 grams somewhere else, that recipe is using a different house conversion or a denser starter. Don't average five websites together like you're setting an interest rate.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading half a cup of sourdough discard is about 113 grams.
pins.claim: Half a Cup of Sourdough Discard Is About 113 Grams.
pins.support: Seen 120 or 125? That is a different house rule.

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: Put the Bowl on the Scale, Hit Tare, and Skip the Sticky Cup
pins.pin_description: Set the mixing bowl on a digital scale, press tare, and spoon sourdough discard in until you hit the number in the recipe. Overshoot by 4 or 5 grams and pancakes will forgive you. For a dough where hydration matters, get closer to the target.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading put the bowl on the scale, hit tare, skip the sticky cup.
pins.claim: Put the Bowl on the Scale, Hit Tare, Skip the Sticky Cup.
pins.support: Overshoot by 4 or 5 grams and nothing happens

pins.board_intended: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.board_routed: Sourdough Discard Recipes and Easy Bread
pins.pin_title: Sourdough Discard: 1 Cup Is 227g, Half a Cup Is 113g, a Quarter Cup Is 57g
pins.pin_description: Three numbers cover almost every sourdough discard recipe you'll open: 227 grams a cup, 113 grams a half cup, 57 grams a quarter cup. Write them on a piece of tape near your scale and stop looking them up at 8 AM with flour on your hands.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin listing 1 cup equals 227g, half a cup 113g, a quarter cup 57g of sourdough discard.
pins.support: Write it on tape and stick it near the scale

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: How to Cook Chicken Breast: Four to Six Minutes a Side, Pulled at 165F
pins.pin_description: The best way to cook chicken breast in a skillet is four to six minutes per side over real heat, pulled at an internal temperature of 165F. Put the thermometer into the thickest part from the side, not from the top, or you'll read the hot pan instead. Under 25 minutes from fridge to fork.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading four to six minutes a side, and a thermometer at 165F.
pins.claim: Four to Six Minutes a Side, and a Thermometer at 165F.
pins.support: That is the whole chicken breast method

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: How to Cook Chicken Breast Without Drying It Out: Even Cutlets
pins.pin_description: A thin edge overcooks while a thick center is still climbing to 165F, and that's most dry chicken right there. Slice the breast horizontally into even cutlets first. The best way to cook chicken is salt, heat and a thermometer, not an overnight marinade pretending Tuesday started yesterday.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading even cutlets solve more than a complicated marinade ever will.
pins.claim: Even Cutlets Solve More Than a Complicated Marinade Ever Will.
pins.support: Slice the breast horizontally before it cooks

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: A 12-Inch Skillet Holds Four Thin Cutlets, and Not One More
pins.pin_description: Crowding traps steam, drops the pan temperature, and leaves you with pale chicken sitting in a puddle. Cook in two batches and keep the first loosely covered on a plate. Everybody learning how to cook chicken in a skillet gets this wrong exactly once.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading a 12-inch skillet holds four thin cutlets, and not one more.
pins.claim: A 12-Inch Skillet Holds Four Thin Cutlets, and Not One More.
pins.support: Crowd the pan and you get pale chicken

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: Rest the Chicken 5 Minutes or the Juice Ends Up on the Board
pins.pin_description: Take the chicken out of the pan and let it sit at least 5 minutes before slicing. Cut too soon and more juice runs onto the board than stays in the meat. Then scrape up the browned bits with a squeeze of lemon and a teaspoon of Dijon, and the best way to cook chicken comes with a sauce attached.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading rest the chicken 5 minutes or the juice ends up on the board.
pins.claim: Rest the Chicken 5 Minutes or the Juice Ends Up on the Board.
pins.support: Then turn the browned bits into a pan sauce

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: Pull Pork Chops at 145F and Rest Them 5 to 10 Minutes
pins.pin_description: 145F is USDA's safe minimum for whole pork chops, followed by at least a 3 minute rest. This method rests them 5 to 10, which is where the juice settles back in. Don't pull at 135F and assume optimism will supply the missing temperature.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading pull pork chops at 145F and rest them 5 to 10 minutes.
pins.claim: Pull Pork Chops at 145F and Rest Them 5 to 10 Minutes.
pins.support: USDA sets 145F plus a 3 minute rest minimum

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: Bone-In Pork Chops About 1 Inch Thick Are the Ones That Survive a Skillet
pins.pin_description: The bone insulates the meat so it cooks more evenly, and good marbling keeps it from drying out. Thin chops are much harder to cook without overdoing them. If you want to know the best way to cook pork chops, the answer starts at the meat counter.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading bone-in pork chops about 1 inch thick are the ones that survive.
pins.claim: Bone-In Pork Chops About 1 Inch Thick Are the Ones That Survive.
pins.support: The bone insulates, the marbling keeps it moist

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: Butter Basting Pork Chops Is 2 to 3 Minutes of Spooning
pins.pin_description: Sear first, then drop in butter with garlic and herbs and spoon it over the pork chops for another 2 to 3 minutes while you watch the thermometer. If the garlic burns, you added it too early. It belongs in the lower heat basting stage, not the sear.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading butter basting is 2 to 3 minutes of spooning, not a secret.
pins.claim: Butter Basting Is 2 to 3 Minutes of Spooning, Not a Secret.
pins.support: Garlic goes in after the sear, never before

pins.board_intended: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.board_routed: How to Cook Chicken, Pork and Beef
pins.pin_title: Pork Chops Thicker Than 1 1/4 Inches Need a 375F Oven Finish
pins.pin_description: Sear both sides, add the aromatics, then move an oven safe skillet into a 375F oven until the center reaches 145F. That's cleaner than burning the garlic while a thick center negotiates with the stove. Thin and boneless chops go the other way and finish faster.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading pork chops thicker than 1 1/4 inches need a 375F oven finish.
pins.claim: Pork Chops Thicker Than 1 1/4 Inches Need a 375F Oven Finish.
pins.support: Cleaner than burning garlic while you wait

pins.pin_title: The Cabbage Slaw Is the Whole Point of a Fish Taco
pins.pin_description: Mayonnaise, lime juice and a minced chipotle in adobo, tossed through two cups of shredded cabbage. That homemade dressing is what makes a fish taco feel like a full plate instead of fish in a tortilla. Make the slaw first and let it sit.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading the cabbage slaw is the whole point, the fish is incidental.
pins.claim: The Cabbage Slaw Is the Whole Point. The Fish Is Incidental.
pins.support: Mayo, lime juice, one minced chipotle

pins.pin_title: Let the Cabbage Slaw Sit 15 Minutes. It Only Gets Better
pins.pin_description: Salt the shredded cabbage while you mix the dressing, then let the whole bowl sit at least 15 minutes. The dressing softens it just enough that you're not crunching through your teeth, and it holds fine if you make the slaw hours ahead.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading let the slaw sit 15 minutes, it only gets better.
pins.claim: Let the Slaw Sit 15 Minutes. It Only Gets Better.
pins.support: The dressing softens it without killing the crunch

pins.pin_title: Fish Tacos With Cabbage Slaw in 20 Minutes, No Fryer
pins.pin_description: A pound of mild white fish seared 2 to 3 minutes a side, warm corn tortillas, and the chipotle cabbage slaw doing the heavy lifting. Four servings at about 340 calories each, and nothing touched a deep fryer or six napkins.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading fish tacos in 20 minutes, no fryer, about 340 calories.
pins.claim: Fish Tacos in 20 Minutes, No Fryer, About 340 Calories.
pins.support: Cabbage slaw does the heavy lifting

pins.pin_title: Red Cabbage Works Fine in a Slaw. It Also Turns Everything Purple
pins.pin_description: Half a small head gets you the two cups you need. Don't stress about perfect shreds, because a mix of thin ribbons and chunkier pieces gives better texture. Red cabbage tastes the same in the slaw and turns it a color you should probably expect.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading red cabbage works fine, it also turns the slaw purple.
pins.claim: Red Cabbage Works Fine. It Also Turns the Slaw Purple.
pins.support: Uneven shreds beat perfect ones for texture

pins.pin_title: Boil, Smash, Roast at 425F: Potato Salad With Actual Crunch
pins.pin_description: Simmer baby potatoes 15 to 20 minutes, smash them flat on an oiled pan, then roast 20 to 25 minutes at 425F until the jagged edges are crisp. This potato salad is a full departure from the cold deli tub version everybody ignores at the barbecue.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading boil, smash, roast at 425F, potato salad with actual crunch.
pins.claim: Boil, Smash, Roast at 425F. Potato Salad With Actual Crunch.
pins.support: 20 to 25 minutes until the edges go golden

pins.pin_title: Toss the Potatoes in Dijon Vinaigrette While They're Still Warm
pins.pin_description: Warm potatoes act like sponges, so they pull in the homemade dressing instead of just wearing it. Whisk olive oil, apple cider vinegar, Dijon, a little honey and minced shallot, then fold it through with parsley and chives. Vinaigrette beats mayonnaise in a potato salad every time.
pins.alt_text: Dark text pin reading toss the potatoes in the Dijon vinaigrette while still warm.
pins.claim: Toss the Potatoes in the Dijon Vinaigrette While Still Warm.
pins.support: Warm potatoes drink up the dressing

pins.pin_title: Potato Salad at a Potluck: Two Hours Out, One Hour Above 90 Degrees
pins.pin_description: A vinaigrette doesn't make cooked potatoes shelf stable. Keep the bowl refrigerated until you serve, then get it back into a cooler within two hours, or one hour when it's above 90 degrees F outside. A larger bowl of ice underneath buys you time.
pins.alt_text: Orange text pin reading potato salad at a potluck, two hours out, one above 90 degrees.
pins.claim: Potato Salad at a Potluck: Two Hours Out, One Above 90 Degrees.
pins.support: Vinaigrette does not make potatoes shelf stable

pins.pin_title: 220 Calories a Serving of Potato Salad, and Not One Spoonful of Mayonnaise
pins.pin_description: A pound and a half of baby potatoes makes six servings at about 220 calories each. The Dijon and vinegar dressing brings acid, which is exactly what heavy starchy food needs. It's the potato salad people actually come back to for seconds.
pins.alt_text: Cream text pin reading 220 calories a serving and not one spoonful of mayonnaise.
pins.claim: 220 Calories a Serving and Not One Spoonful of Mayonnaise.
pins.support: A pound and a half of potatoes, six servings
